name: what-if-calculator
label: What-if Calculator
description: Show trends in LogiSheets workbooks for analysis

scripts.build: vite build && craftsmith build . && yarn copy-to-public
scripts.copy-to-public: rm -rf ../../public/what-if-calculator&& mkdir -p ../../public/what-if-calculator&& cp index.html ../../public/what-if-calculator/index.html && cp dist/what-if-calculator.js ../../public/what-if-calculator/what-if-calculator.js && cp dist/manifest.json ../../public/what-if-calculator/manifest.json && cp dist/tools.js ../../public/what-if-calculator/tools.js
